Staff

The people operating the service.

JohnHost is a small operation and is intended to stay that way — no large corporate team, just people who play the game and wanted hosting without a monthly cost.

JohnDinglesin

Owner & Founder

JohnHost was founded on a straightforward idea: hosting a Minecraft server should not require a monthly subscription just to play with friends. JohnDinglesin handles node operations, the network, capacity decisions, and availability.
